name: POD compression + DMD rollout of a linear system
description: examples/architectures/30_rom_pod_dmd.py: 16 trajectories of 60 steps of a contractive random linear system in 128 dimensions (pinneapple_neural.architectures.rom.toy_systems), POD of rank 12, DMD on the POD coefficients, rollout decoded to the state space. Nothing committed: the script prints the two MSEs (the flow prints the same numbers).
